tips.text: Jump in with To the Skies! to get the enemy slowed, then swing Thundering Blow while they can't get away.
Fire Shock Blast from long range to poke, and stop when minions are in the way, since the bolt blows up on the first enemy it touches.
Drop Acceleration Gate first, then shoot Shock Blast through it for a faster, longer and stronger bolt.
Use Lightning Field when you land next to the enemy; it keeps hurting them for a few seconds.
Swap stances often with Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer; each swap gives a burst of speed and lets you walk through units.
Hit with your first Cannon attack to shred the enemy's Armor and Magic Resist, then follow with your damage.
Press your advantage in the early levels; Jayce is strong there, so trade often while ahead.
When you take a lot of damage, switch to hammer form; it gives extra defenses.
Hit enemies with hammer attacks to get Mana back through Lightning Field, so you can keep trading.

combos.name: Gate Shock Blast
combos.when: In Cannon Stance when you want a long-range poke or a fast, harder-hitting bolt at a distant target.
combos.text: Place the Acceleration Gate close to you, then fire Shock Blast through it. The bolt gets faster, goes farther and deals more damage.

combos.name: Lightning Field mid-leap
combos.when: When you leap onto an enemy and want the field's damage running as you land.
combos.text: Lightning Field can be cast while Jayce is still in the air from To the Skies!. Use it during the dash so no time is lost.

tips.text: Open a fight with To the Skies! on a target to close the gap and leave them slowed, then follow up with Thundering Blow.
Drop Acceleration Gate in front of you, then fire Shock Blast through it for a faster, longer, harder-hitting shot.
Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it so a minion or monster does not soak it before your target.
Use Hyper Charge before a string of basic attacks on a big target. Your next few hits get much faster.
In hammer form, Lightning Field hits everything around you, and your hammer attacks give back mana. Use it when you are surrounded.
Use Thundering Blow on tanky targets, since it deals damage based on their max health. It knocks them back, so use it to push them away or into your team.
Swap stances with Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to chase or escape. The swap gives a short burst of speed and lets you walk through units.
Swap stance right before a basic attack. The first hit after a swap does extra damage or lowers the target's defenses.
Stay at range in Cannon form and poke with Shock Blast. Aatrox wants to be close, so keep him away from you.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Aatrox back when he dashes in. Then swap to Cannon form and keep your distance.
Step out of The Darkin Blade's edge, because the edge is the part that hits hardest and knocks you up. Move sideways, not straight back.
When Infernal Chains lands on you, walk out of the area before it ends, toward the sides or toward Aatrox, so you are not pulled back.
Use To the Skies! to close on Aatrox or to leave after a trade, since it slows nearby enemies.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes from range, which suits dodging Aatrox's Darkin Blade and chains while he heals.

tips.text: Hit Akali with Thundering Blow when she dives in; it roots her briefly and knocks her back, which breaks her combo.
Stay in Cannon Stance at range and use Shock Blast early; Akali has to get close to you to do damage.
When Akali hides in Twilight Shroud, use Lightning Field on the smoke; area damage still hits her and shows where she is.
Switch to Hammer Stance when Akali has her ultimate up; the extra defenses help you survive her burst.
Press your early lead when Akali is low on energy, since she cannot cast Five Point Strike freely.
Knock Ambessa back with Thundering Blow when she dashes in; it roots her briefly and hits harder against her health.
Poke with Shock Blast from long range, since she has to close the gap to fight you.
Switch to Hammer Stance when she goes in on you; the extra defenses help you survive her trade.
Use Lightning Field when she steps up to you; it hurts her over time as she fights.
Leap away from her with To the Skies! after she spends her abilities, because the slow keeps her from chasing.
Stay out of a straight line with Anivia. Flash Frost slows you and stuns you when it detonates.
Use To the Skies! to close the gap on Anivia, then hit her with Thundering Blow.
Poke Anivia with Shock Blast from range. Send it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Do not walk through Glacial Storm while it is fully formed. It slows you more and hurts more.
Do not waste your burst on her egg. Wait until it hatches and fight her again.
Use Shock Blast from long range in Cannon Stance to chip Aurora, and step out of reach of her The Weirding before she can answer.
Aurora's Across the Veil makes her invisible for a moment. Don't chase blindly; wait for her to reappear before you commit.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Aurora back and away from your lane, or into a bad spot, once she is in hammer range.
Swap stances to get a burst of speed when you want to close the gap or break away from her slows.
Hold your Lightning Field for when she is on top of you; it deals damage over time to anyone nearby.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Briar back when she leaps in; it briefly roots her first, and the knockback ends her Blood Frenzy chase for a moment.
Fight Briar in Cannon Stance and keep your distance. She has to leap to reach you, so poke her while she walks up.
Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it where minions will not block it before you fire at Briar.
Swap to Hammer Stance when Briar goes on you; it gives you extra Armor and Magic Resist for the fight.
Switch stances to speed up and slip past minions when you need to run away; Hextech Capacitor lets you walk through units.
Do not spend all your cooldowns before Briar jumps on you, because her Head Rush stuns and she heals from her bleed. Keep Thundering Blow for her dive.

comboRefs.note: Leaping in with Lightning Field running punishes Briar when she stays close in her Blood Frenzy.

tips.text: Fight Camille in Cannon Stance and poke her with Shock Blast from range; she has to close the gap before she can trade.
Use Thundering Blow when Camille dives in. It knocks her back, so her follow-up attack falls short.
Hit Camille's outer-edge Tactical Sweep range with Shock Blast before she gets close; the sweep takes a while to land, so you can step out of it.
Change stance as Camille's Hookshot comes at you. You gain Move Speed and can walk through units, which helps you get away.
Camille's shield only blocks one damage type. Use the other type when her Adaptive Defenses shield is up.
Keep out of Rupture's smoke circle and sidestep it. Once you are knocked up, Cho'Gath can follow with Feral Scream.
Poke with Shock Blast from long range in cannon stance. Cho'Gath has to walk up to you, and you can hit him before he reaches you.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Cho'Gath away when he gets close. In hammer stance you also take less damage.
Stop Cho'Gath from growing by denying his minion kills. Press him early before Feast stacks make him a tank.
Do not leap in with To the Skies! when Feral Scream is ready, or you will be silenced and unable to cast anything.
Poke Darius with Shock Blast from long range and keep your distance in cannon form. He is weak when far from you.
When Darius runs at you, knock him away with Thundering Blow. Use it before he gets to stack Hemorrhage on you.
Trade right after Darius uses Apprehend, since it has a long cooldown and he is easier to poke afterward.
Don't stand still at the front of the lane. Darius's Apprehend pulls you in, and Crippling Strike will slow you.
Poke Mundo from range with Shock Blast, and try to stay at range. Fire it through Acceleration Gate for more damage and range.
Don't waste Thundering Blow on Mundo's first root. Goes Where He Pleases blocks it and he heals from the canister.
Step on the canister to destroy it before Mundo can pick it up.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw. It deals damage based on his target's current health and slows you.
Stay out of melee when Mundo has Heart Zapper up. He heals back what he stores, so wait for it to end.
Don't cast Thundering Blow when Fiora's Riposte is ready. She can turn the root into a stun on you.
Poke with Shock Blast from range and keep Fiora out of melee. Her Lunge closes the gap, so stay back.
Bait Riposte with a weak ability first, then use To the Skies! and Thundering Blow once she has used it.
Knock Fiora away with Thundering Blow after she Lunges at you. It breaks up her trade, but only once Riposte is down.
Fiora is strongest once she gets items, so push your early lead and don't let her scale up.
Stay out of Gangplank's keg range when you are in cannon form; poke him with Shock Blast instead of trading up close.
Do not leap in with To the Skies! near his kegs; an exploding keg will slow you and hurt.
Save Thundering Blow for when Remove Scurvy is on cooldown; he can cleanse the root otherwise.

comboRefs.note: Long-range Shock Blast through the Gate pokes Gangplank from afar, out of keg range.

tips.text: Poke with Shock Blast from range and stay away from Garen. Fire it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Hit Garen with an attack while the Cannon is out to cut his armor and magic resist before you trade.
Save Thundering Blow to knock Garen back when he runs at you. Casting it also roots him for a moment.
Don't count on slowing Garen. Decisive Strike removes the slow and speeds him up.
Back away when you are low. Demacian Justice finishes you quickly.
Keep damaging Garen so Perseverance can't heal him; he regenerates fast if left alone.
Poke Gnar with Shock Blast from range while he is small; his Boomerang Throw reaches far, so sidestep it.
Place Acceleration Gate and fire Shock Blast through it for longer range and more damage than Gnar expects.
Knock Gnar back with Thundering Blow when he turns Mega and runs at you, then walk away from his reach.
Stay away from walls when Gnar is Mega; GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into one.
Trade in melee with To the Skies! and Lightning Field right after Gnar uses his Hop, while it is on cooldown.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes Gnar from long range, and Gnar's Boomerang Throw is the main poke he can answer with.

tips.text: Stay out of reach of Body Slam; it stuns you and sets up the rest of Gragas's combo.
Step out of Barrel Roll's area before it explodes; staying in it leaves you slowed and hurt.
Poke with Shock Blast from range and keep Gragas from reaching you; he has to close the gap.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Gragas back after he slams in, then swap stances to get away.
Do not stand beside your own tower while Gragas's ultimate is ready; Explosive Cask can knock you into danger.
Press your early advantage with Jayce, and back off if Gragas starts winning trades.
Poke Gwen with Shock Blast from long range in cannon form; she has to close the gap to hit you.
Hold Thundering Blow for when Gwen walks up to trade; it knocks her back and breaks her attack rhythm.
Don't waste burst while Gwen stands in Hallowed Mist; enemies outside it can't target her. Wait until she leaves or the mist ends.
Gwen gets stronger the more she attacks, so use Mercury Cannon range to keep her from landing hits.
Dodge between Needlework casts; her follow-ups need her to hit something first. Sidestep the first needle.
Stay out of turret range and hit Heimerdinger with Shock Blast from far away. Fight him away from his turrets.
Don't leap in while his stun grenade is ready, since being stunned leaves you open.
Go in on Heimerdinger once his ultimate is on cooldown.
Be strong early and push the advantage. If you get ahead, Heimerdinger has to play defensively and can't set up turrets.
Stay away from his Hextech Micro-Rockets in a straight line. Sidestep them when you walk toward him.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes Heimerdinger from long range, so he has to fight away from his turrets.

tips.text: Poke Illaoi with Shock Blast from long range while you are in Cannon form; stay out of her Tentacle Smash line.
Fight away from Illaoi's Tentacles; they hit hard and heal her when they hit you. Pull the fight to open ground.
Hit Illaoi with Thundering Blow to knock her back when she leaps at you with Harsh Lesson, then walk away.
If Illaoi pulls your spirit with Test of Spirit, fight her. Hitting her cuts the spirit's time, so use your burst on her.
Use To the Skies! to close in or escape; the slow helps you leave.
Jayce is strongest early, so push your lead before she gets Leap of Faith at level 6.
Stay out of Irelia's range in cannon form and poke her; she wants to be close.
Do not throw Shock Blast while Irelia charges Defiant Dance; it cuts the damage she takes and she cannot be interrupted.
Watch for Flawless Duet blades on the ground and step out of the line between them, or you will be stunned.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Irelia back when she dashes in, then swap forms and shoot her.
Fight away from minion waves; Irelia uses Bladesurge on minions to reach you.
Stay at range in Cannon form and use Shock Blast on Jax. Do not let him leap onto you for free.
Do not auto-attack Jax while Counter Strike is up; he dodges it and then stuns you. Wait until his stance ends before you hit him.
Hit Jax in short bursts. Cutting his attacks short keeps Relentless Assault from building his attack speed.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Jax back when he leaps in. It roots him briefly first and gives you room to switch stances.
Press your early lead before Jax reaches level 6. His Grandmaster-at-Arms makes him tanky and hurts your trades.
Poke with Shock Blast from long range in Cannon form, and stay out of reach of K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes.
Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way soak it. Line up your shots to hit K'Sante.
Hit the Ntofo Strikes shockwave only when you must. When K'Sante has two stacks, stay away from his Ntofo Strikes, because it pulls and stuns you.
Use Thundering Blow to knock K'Sante away when he charges Path Maker at you, then step out of the dash's line.
Walk away from the stun when K'Sante charges Path Maker, since it can't be interrupted. Dodge sideways rather than using To the Skies!.
Be careful near walls when K'Sante has his ultimate. All Out can pull you across terrain and hit you twice.
Pressure Kayle hard before level 6; she is a weak melee champion until she ascends.
Poke with Shock Blast while she is still melee, and send it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Once Kayle has range, Thundering Blow knocks her back and her damage is tied to her health, so land it in a fight when she is close.
Do not burst into Kayle while her Divine Judgment is ready; she can become Invulnerable and you waste your abilities.
Do not let Kennen mark you three times. Stay away from his abilities while you carry marks, or you will be stunned.
Kennen is fragile, so jump on him with To the Skies! when he spends Lightning Rush carelessly.
Sidestep Thundering Shuriken or hide behind a minion. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Push Kennen away with Thundering Blow when he rushes in. It also breaks his attempt to stack marks on you.
Poke Kled with Shock Blast from long range while he is mounted; stay out of his reach and make him walk into your shots.
When Kled closes in, use Thundering Blow to knock him back, then swap to the Cannon and shoot him again.
Hit Kled with Shock Blast to break his Bear Trap on a Rope tether; if you are hooked, move away from him quickly.
Use the speed from Hextech Capacitor when you swap stances to slip away from Kled's Jousting dash.
Back off when Kled's Violent Tendencies is ready; his fourth hit hurts a lot.
Poke Malphite from range with Shock Blast. Shoot it through an Acceleration Gate to make it faster and stronger.
Break his Granite Shield with a ranged poke before you trade. Without it his Armor is much lower.
Stay out of Seismic Shard range when you can; the slow ruins your leaps and lets him chase.
Stay wary of his level 6 Unstoppable Force, because you can't escape it once it starts. Keep some distance from him.
Don't commit to Hyper Charge when Ground Slam is ready; it cuts your Attack Speed.
Poke with Shock Blast from range and stay out of Mordekaiser's reach. Fire it through Acceleration Gate for extra range.
Stay out of a straight line from Mordekaiser and sidestep Death's Grasp. It pulls you into his Obliterate and aura.
Do not fight him long in melee. Once his Darkness Rise aura is on, back away.
Wait for his Indestructible shield to run out before committing. Do not waste damage on it.
Keep Thundering Blow ready as an escape to knock him back when he runs in. Your stance swap also gives you speed to get away.
Poke with Shock Blast from long range in Cannon form; Naafiri has to cross a long gap to reach you.
When Naafiri dives onto you, switch to Hammer form and use Thundering Blow to knock her back.
Use Lightning Field when her Packmates are around you; it damages every enemy nearby.
Hold your Hammer swap for her Hounds' Pursuit; you can step away with the Hextech Capacitor speed boost when she lands.
Naafiri is untargetable during The Call of the Pack, so do not waste To the Skies! or Thundering Blow on her then.

comboRefs.note: Lightning Field mid-leap starts damaging at landing, hitting Naafiri and the packmates around her.

tips.text: Stay in Cannon Stance early and use Shock Blast to hit Nasus while he walks up for last hits.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Nasus away when he commits to you; it also roots him briefly first.
Don't let Nasus catch you with Wither; it slows you more each second and cuts your Attack Speed. Kite him and stay out of range.
Don't stand in melee with Nasus once Fury of the Sands is active. Back off and wait for it to end.
Poke with Shock Blast from range and do not let Olaf close in. He is much stronger in a long, close fight.
Stay out of Undertow's line, and walk away from the axe on the ground. If Olaf cannot get it back, his cooldown stays long.
Do not rely on Thundering Blow or To the Skies! once Ragnarok is active, because Olaf is immune to those effects.
Do not leave Olaf at low Health with a fight still going. Berserker Rage makes him hit faster and heal more.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is close, because Searing Charge into terrain knocks you up and stuns you.
Trade from range in Cannon Stance with Shock Blast, then step back before Ornn can close the gap.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture. It stops at the first champion it hits and leaves a pillar behind, so don't fight next to that spot.
Keep Thundering Blow for when Ornn walks in on you, to knock him back and hold him still for a moment.
Fight early. Ornn gets much stronger once he forges items and upgrades them, so push your lead while he is weak.
Use the speed from switching stances to dodge Bellows Breath. If the flames land, Ornn's attacks knock you back, so back off.
Keep Jayce in Cannon stance and poke Pantheon with Shock Blast before he reaches you.
Do not hit Pantheon while Aegis Assault faces you; step around to his side or wait for it to end.
Knock Pantheon away with Thundering Blow as he jumps in, so his empowered hits come apart.
Stay healthy; a thrown Comet Spear hurts you far more when you are low.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, move out of the target area; it gives you a long warning.
Start fights in Cannon Stance and hit Quinn with Shock Blast from long range; she has no way to trade back until she closes in.
When Quinn uses Vault on you, hit her with Thundering Blow to knock her back out of her bonus attack.
Use To the Skies! to close the gap on Quinn, then Lightning Field on top of her while she is slowed and trying to leave.
Play in Hammer Stance when Quinn is marked by Harrier and about to trade, since it gives you extra defenses.
If Quinn goes into Behind Enemy Lines, hit her; damage removes her speed boost, and being rooted or stunned ends it.
Poke Renekton from range with Shock Blast in Cannon Stance, and stay away so he can't build Fury.
Back off when Renekton's Fury is high; Ruthless Predator then stuns for much longer.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Renekton away when he dashes in; it also roots him briefly before the hit.
Hold To the Skies! as an escape or to close in after Renekton has spent Slice and Dice.
Keep Jayce at range in cannon form and poke with Shock Blast. Riven has no ranged attack to answer.
Riven wants to stun you with Ki Burst, so step back when she gets close. Do not stand next to her.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Riven back when she dives in, then fire Shock Blast as she tries to come back.
Her Valor shield absorbs your poke, so hold your damage until the shield is gone.
Her damage is all physical, so swap to hammer form when she goes all in; it gives you extra defense.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes Riven from long range, so she must close the gap through the bolt.

tips.text: Stay out of melee range of Rumble's Flamespitter. Hit him with Shock Blast from range, since the bolt stops at the first enemy it meets.
When Rumble overheats, he can't cast spells for a few seconds. Jump in with Thundering Blow and trade freely.
Early on, press Rumble hard with both stances. Jayce is strong early, and Rumble gets stronger as he levels and builds Heat.
Lightning Field in hammer form hurts him while he stands on you. Use it to punish Rumble when he walks up to trade.
Step out of The Equalizer's fire quickly. Standing in it costs you a lot of health and leaves you slowed.
Poke Sett with Shock Blast from long range in Cannon form, and stay out of his reach so he can't trade punches.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Sett back when he closes in, then follow with To the Skies! to get away or keep fighting.
Do not stand next to Sett when his Facebreaker is ready. If an enemy is on each side of you, you get stunned.
Sett's Haymaker hits hardest after he has taken a lot of damage. Trading with him gives him a big shield, so poke from range and don't fight into it.
Swap forms and use Hextech Capacitor's speed to step out of Haymaker's blast after you see him wind it up.
Fight Sett early, before he has built up health and damage. Win lane early, because he gets stronger the longer the fight goes.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes from long range, keeping Jayce away from Sett's short-range punches.

tips.text: Do not stand in a straight line when Shen has Shadow Dash ready. If he taunts you, you must attack him and he can trade freely.
Stay in cannon stance and poke Shen with Shock Blast. He has no ranged way to answer it.
Do not fight into Spirit's Refuge. It blocks your basic attacks, so wait for it to end before you attack.
Shen's Spirit Blade slows you when it flies back. Move toward him rather than away to avoid the slow, or fight from range.
Once Shen is level 6, watch for his ultimate pulling him to an ally. Be careful about pushing too far when he is away.
Stay out of Poison Trail by poking from range in Cannon stance. Don't walk through the cloud to trade.
Keep away from Fling range. Thundering Blow can knock Singed back if he gets too close.
Don't leap in with To the Skies! when Mega Adhesive is down, or you will be slowed and flung into a root.
Shock Blast flies at fixed speed and stops at the first enemy it hits. Fire it at Singed before he reaches you.
Keep Sion at range with Shock Blast in Cannon form. Don't stand where his Roar of the Slayer can reach you.
Sion's Decimating Smash is slow to charge and its aim is easy to read. Step out of the way, or knock him back with Thundering Blow to break the charge.
Hold your damage while Sion's Soul Furnace shield is up. Poke after it breaks or fades.
Fight early, before Sion gets large on Health. Press your lead and don't let him farm for free.
Watch for Sion at level 6. Stay out of a straight line with him, because Unstoppable Onslaught is hard to dodge once he is close.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes from long range, safely outside Sion's short-range Roar and Smash.

tips.text: Poke with Shock Blast from long range while you are in Cannon form, and stay out of Tongue Lash range so he can't hit you.
Don't let him hit you three times. Full stacks let his next Tongue Lash stun you, and then he can swallow you with Devour.
Hit him with Thundering Blow to knock him back when he walks up to fight. Do it before he has stacks.
When Tahm Kench starts Abyssal Dive, step out of the area it will land on. Once he lands he can't act for a moment, so punish him.
Hit him with Shock Blast when his grey health shows. Keep poking so he can't heal it back, because it only returns after a few seconds without damage.
Dodge Teemo's Blinding Dart by staying behind minions. A blind makes your basic attacks miss in Hammer Stance.
Look for the mushrooms from Noxious Trap in brush and on your path before you leap. They slow you and reveal you.
Use To the Skies! to close the gap on Teemo, then use Thundering Blow to knock him back from his poison.
Poke Teemo from range with Shock Blast. Avoid walking up for long trades, because Toxic Shot keeps hurting you after you back off.
If Teemo vanishes with Guerrilla Warfare, don't walk up to the spot blindly. He gets bonus attack speed when he comes out.
Stay at range in Cannon Stance and poke with Shock Blast. Tryndamere has trouble reaching you.
Harass early so Tryndamere can't build Fury and heal with Bloodlust.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Tryndamere back when he dives you, then swap stances and run with Hextech Capacitor.
Don't spend everything on Tryndamere while Undying Rage is ready. Wait it out, then finish him.

comboRefs.note: Gate Shock Blast pokes from long range, so Tryndamere has to close the gap through the bolt's range.

tips.text: Stay out of Urgot's Disdain range. If it connects, you are stunned and thrown behind him while his legs and Purge hit you.
Poke Urgot from range with Shock Blast in cannon form. Fire it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Urgot back when he runs at you. Hammer form also gives you extra defenses.
Avoid taking several of Urgot's leg blasts in one trade. Back off after a hit while those legs are on cooldown.
Stay healthy when Fear Beyond Death hits you. Don't drop low until it ends, or Urgot can drag you in and execute you.
Jump on Varus with To the Skies! when his Piercing Arrow is on cooldown, since he is weak up close.
Stay out of Varus's long range while he charges Piercing Arrow. Step out of its line to dodge it.
Hit Varus with Thundering Blow while he is close. It knocks him back and deals damage based on his max health.
Play carefully once Varus reaches level 6, because Chain of Corruption roots you. Stay out of his line.
Don't let Varus stack Blight on you. His abilities then hit much harder, so trade in short bursts.
Stay off walls when Vayne is near. Condemn into terrain stuns you and adds big damage.
Poke Vayne with Shock Blast from range. She is fragile, so make her play cautiously.
Leap onto Vayne with To the Skies! to slow her, then use Thundering Blow to knock her away from you.
Don't trade for long with Vayne. Every third hit from Silver Bolts deals extra damage, so break off and swap stances.
Poke Vladimir with Shock Blast from range and avoid trading up close, where Transfusion heals him.
Place the Acceleration Gate and fire Shock Blast through it for longer range and more damage. Vladimir has trouble answering that from afar.
Don't use To the Skies! to jump in while Sanguine Pool is ready; he can drop into the pool and leave you slowed in his damage.
Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so Vladimir can block it with minions in the way. Aim for clear lines.
Be strong early, and hit Vladimir before he gets his core items; he gets stronger and tankier later.
Poke Volibear with Shock Blast from range and keep your distance. He wants to reach you with Thundering Smash.
Hit Volibear with Thundering Blow as he runs in with Thundering Smash. The root ends his charge and refreshes its cooldown.
Slow Volibear with To the Skies! and then back off; his Frenzied Maul heals him if he hits you twice.
Stay out of his Sky Splitter circle. Step out before it lands, because it hits hard and slows you.
Poke Xin Zhao with Shock Blast from far away, and keep him out of melee range.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Xin Zhao back when he charges in; it breaks up his fight.
Hit Xin Zhao's third Three Talon Strike attack? Avoid it by backing off before the knock up lands.
Stay away from Xin Zhao when his Wind Becomes Lightning is ready; the slow makes you easy to catch.
Fight early; Jayce is strong in the early levels, so trade with Shock Blast and back off before Yasuo's shield and damage come online.
Aim Shock Blast so it lands on Yasuo directly; a minion in the way makes it explode there instead.
Yasuo can block your Shock Blast with Wind Wall, so wait for the wall to end before firing.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Yasuo back when he dashes in. It briefly roots him first.
Stay in Cannon form at range and poke him. His tornado is the main thing to dodge.
Poke Yone with Shock Blast from long range in Cannon Stance; he has no ranged answer, so keep your distance.
When Yone walks up, use Thundering Blow to knock him back, then follow with To the Skies! to stay on him.
Swap to Hammer Stance when Yone starts trading; it gives you extra armor and magic resist.
Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it at Yone when no minion is in the way.
Hammer Stance can be knocked up by Yone's Mortal Steel after two hits, so do not let him land two thrusts on you.
Stay at range in cannon form and poke Yorick; he has little way to reach you without Mourning Mist.
Dodge the Mourning Mist, because it slows you and lowers your Armor, which sets up Yorick's trade.
Kill Mist Walkers early with basic attacks or Lightning Field; each one dies to a single attack or spell.
Attack Dark Procession to break it down, or walk away; do not stand inside the ring and fight Yorick.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Yorick away when he tries to fight you, then switch to cannon and poke him.
Poke with Shock Blast from long range while Zaahen has to walk up to you; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep minions out of its path.
When Zaahen dashes in, use Thundering Blow to knock him back out of his fight; it also roots him briefly before the hit.
Don't hold your ground in the hammer stance when Zaahen has many stacks; his damage grows the longer a fight goes on, so trade and step away.
Aim Shock Blast so it doesn't line up with minions when Zaahen is about to throw Dreaded Return; step sideways out of its narrow line instead.
Don't count on a kill when Zaahen is full of stacks from Cultivation of War; he can revive and become untargetable instead of dying.
Walk out of Smoke Screen quickly; the slow and the sight block end when you leave the cloud.
Land Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate on Graves when he is close; it roots him briefly, then knocks him back, and it hurts more against high-health targets.
Poke Graves with Shock Blast from afar; send it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Do not walk through the powder trail of End of the Line; it blows up behind its path after a short delay and hits you.
Fight Graves early, before he has built up his items; Jayce is strong in the early game.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike knocks up anyone in that path.
Poke Jarvan from range with Shock Blast. Cast it through Acceleration Gate for more range and damage.
Hit Jarvan with Thundering Blow in hammer form when he commits. It knocks him back and breaks his engage.
Swap stances to get a burst of move speed. Use it to leave a Cataclysm fight early.
Kayn needs to damage you before Umbral Trespass works, so keep him at range with Shock Blast and don't let him land Blade's Reach on you.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Kayn back when he dives on you, then swap to the cannon and poke him.
Hit Kayn with the empowered cannon attack before a trade; it strips his Armor and Magic Resist.
Look for fights early, since Jayce is strong early. Kayn gets much stronger once he transforms, so don't let him fight freely on his terms.
If Kayn leaves in terrain with Shadow Step, don't chase. Lightning Field and the speed from swapping stances help you disengage.
Stay near minions or allies so Kha'Zix can't treat you as isolated, which makes Taste Their Fear hit far weaker.
Hit him with Thundering Blow when he lands on you; it knocks him back and gives you space.
Hold To the Skies! to escape or to hit back after he jumps in, since it leaves nearby enemies slowed.
Kha'Zix is weak while Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown. Take that window to poke and push him off the lane.
Hit Kindred with Thundering Blow when she is alone; it roots her briefly and knocks her back, and the damage is based on her health.
Kindred is fragile, so chase her with To the Skies! and slow her down, then punish her right after she uses Dance of Arrows.
Open from long range with Shock Blast in Cannon form. Kindred has to come to you, and you can switch stances to get away.
Do not fight inside Wolf's Frenzy, because Wolf keeps biting you. Wait for it to end or pull her out of the area.
Back off when Lamb's Respite goes down, because no one inside it can die. Wait for it to end before you finish a fight.
Keep Lee Sin away with Thundering Blow in hammer form. It knocks him back and breaks his chase after Resonating Strike.
Stay behind minions or sidestep so Sonic Wave hits something else first. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Poke him from range with Shock Blast. Lee Sin has little ranged damage, so fight early when you are strong.
Stay spread from your team so Dragon's Rage can't knock one of you into the others.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so use Lightning Field when he is on top of you. It also hurts him if he dives you.
Knock Master Yi back with Thundering Blow when he closes in, then switch to Cannon and shoot him.
Keep Shock Blast for after Master Yi uses Highlander; slows will not work, so rely on Thundering Blow to stop him.
Hit Master Yi hard while he is vulnerable; once he uses Alpha Strike you cannot target him, so wait it out.
Poke him when he is low; Meditate heals him over time, so hit him again when it ends.
Use Thundering Blow on Naafiri when she dives in; it roots her briefly, then knocks her back out of your face.
Swap to hammer form when she closes in; you get extra defenses and move speed from Hextech Capacitor.
Open from range with Shock Blast and keep your distance; she wants to jump on you and burst you.
Slow her with To the Skies! after she commits to a fight so she cannot run you down.
Save Thundering Blow for when Nocturne tries to commit; the knockback breaks his tether and keeps him away from you.
Break Unspeakable Horror's tether by getting out of its range, and use To the Skies! to jump away.
Stay near your allies when Paranoia is cast, since Nocturne can dash in from far away.
Don't waste Shock Blast while Shroud of Darkness is up; it blocks one Ability, so bait it first.
Stay at range with Shock Blast and wear Shyvana down early. She is weak against anyone who keeps their distance.
Use Thundering Blow to knock Shyvana back when she runs at you, then swap forms and step away.
Poke Shyvana while her Dragon Fury is low. She can't turn into a dragon without it.
Use To the Skies! to get away if Shyvana catches you, since it leaves her slowed.
Keep your distance from Skarner in Cannon Stance. Poke with Shock Blast so he can't reach you.
Hit Skarner with Thundering Blow to knock him back out of his charge range or away from you. Do it when he closes in.
Skarner's Ixtal's Impact can be stopped by a stun, root or knock-up. Keep a control ability ready when he comes for you.
Sidestep Impale or use the speed from swapping stances to get out of its reach.
Keep Jayce in Cannon Stance and fire Shock Blast from long range; Sylas has to close the gap and you can punish him as he walks in.
Place Acceleration Gate and fire Shock Blast through it for longer range and more damage.
When Sylas dashes onto you, switch to Hammer Stance and use Thundering Blow to knock him back and break his trade.
Swap stances to get a burst of speed and walk through units when you need to escape his chains.
Hit Sylas with a basic attack right after switching to Cannon Stance; it lowers his Armor and Magic Resist for your burst.
Avoid fighting Sylas when he is low on Health; Kingslayer heals him more the lower he is.
Place Acceleration Gate and fire Shock Blast through it at Talon when he comes in. It reaches farther and hits harder.
Switch to hammer form when Talon is close. It gives you extra defenses, and Thundering Blow knocks him back.
Watch for Talon vaulting walls. He can show up behind you, so stay away from the walls near your camps.
Once Talon uses Shadow Assault, he has no escape. Fight him then.
Stay in Hammer Stance and use Thundering Blow to knock Viego away from you or into a wall when he commits. It briefly roots him first.
Open from range with Shock Blast. Viego has to walk up to you, so keep him out of reach.
Jump on Viego with To the Skies! to get close and leave him slowed, which makes it harder for him to escape or chase you.
Don't let Viego win a fight near a kill. He will turn the dead champion into a wraith and take over their body, so back off when your ally is about to die.
Hit Viego with Lightning Field when he is close to you. It damages him over time, so use it when he stays in melee.
Keep Xin Zhao off you with Thundering Blow in Hammer form; it knocks him back after a short root.
Use Shock Blast from range while Xin Zhao closes in; don't let him finish his third attack with Three Talon Strike or you get knocked up.
Stay spread from your team until Xin Zhao has used Crescent Guard, then fight back; the enemy can't hit you with it from far away.
Swap stance with Hextech Capacitor to get a burst of speed and run through units when Xin Zhao charges in.
